description: Places the quoted order and pays it with the saved card within the key caps (D7: monthly / annual servers included). Servers are then provisioned with the first SSH key of the account. Requires the confirmationToken of gpucloud_quote_order. [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: orders:create) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous call (valid 10 minutes, single use).

country.description: Billing country (default: the one of the last order, else CA).

quantity.description: Always 1: one order line = one GPU server. To order several servers, add one line per server.

province.description: Province code for taxes, e.g. QC, ON (default: the one of the last order, else QC).

name: gpucloud_create_order
title: Place an order (charges the card)
